title: vl04: 'carries over to the infinite-dimensional case as well' overstates the matrix-element formula

legacy.old_text: genau deshalb trägt sie auch im unendlich-dimensionalen Fall
that is exactly why it carries over to the infinite-dimensional case as well

reason: In infinite dimension the double sum is a series whose convergence, and the operator's domain, must be checked; for an unbounded operator it does not hold for every vector. The statement 'it carries over' is therefore too strong without these qualifications. The new script text restricts the chapter to finite index sets (line 59) and does not repeat the claim; the course softens it in c03.s11 and c03.v5.
